inputKind: a String holding a JSON object whose "orders" key is an array of order objects; each has a "sku" (a string) and a "qty" (a number), and may have a "price" (a number) and a "tags" array of strings

tasks.prompt: Leave the total of qty times price over the orders that have a price; an order without a price contributes nothing.
tasks.reference: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'O' BIND O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP O [ 'price' GET ] MAP MUL [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 [ ADD ] FOLD

tasks.prompt: Leave that same total (as in orders.revenue) as a String with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
tasks.reference: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'O' BIND O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP O [ 'price' GET ] MAP MUL [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 [ ADD ] FOLD 2 FORMAT

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector of the distinct skus of the orders that have no price, in order of first appearance.
tasks.reference: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'price' GET NIL? ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE

tasks.prompt: Leave a Record from each sku to the sum of its qty, skus in order of first appearance.
tasks.reference: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD

tasks.prompt: Leave the sku whose qty sums to the most; when several tie, the one that appears first.
tasks.reference: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET

tasks.prompt: Leave a Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it, tags in order of first appearance.
tasks.reference: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'tags' GET ] MAP [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER FLATTEN TALLY
